newsitem.title: USA: Atria Communities offers six mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Atria Communities offers six mln shares.

text.p: Atria Communities Inc said Thursday it publicly offered six million shares of common stock at $14 a share.
All the shares were sold by Atria, which granted an over-allotment option to the underwriters for an additional 900,000 shares.
Atria said it plans to use the net proceeds from the offering to finance the development and acquisition of assisted living communities and for general corporate purposes.
Alex. Brown & Sons Inc is the lead manager of the offering, with J.C. Bradford & Co. and Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corp acting as co-managers, Atria said.
Before the offering, Atria had about 16.5 million shares of common stock outstanding.
Shares of Atria lost 1 to 14-1/2 at midday.
